info.name: Event Registration API
info.description:
Walks the event workflow: draft and publish, registration, capacity, the waitlist and automatic promotion, admin participant lists, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8118). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and creates a uniquely named event each run.

exec: const iso = (days, hours) => new Date(Date.now() + days * 864e5 + hours * 36e5).toISOString().slice(0, 16);

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run
2. Admin creates and publishes an event
Create an event with one seat (starts as a draft)

exec: pm.test("Draft with nobody registered", () => { pm.expect(e.status).to.eql("DRAFT"); pm.expect(e.confirmed).to.eql(0); pm.expect(e.spotsLeft).to.eql(1); });

item.name: An event in the past cannot be created
A draft is invisible to employees

exec: pm.test("Says it is not open", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("not open"));
pm.test("Found with its single seat", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].spotsLeft).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].myStatus).to.eql(null); });

item.name: A different category filter hides it
Joining the waitlist twice is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Exactly my one", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(l[0].status).to.eql("CONFIRMED"); });
pm.test("Position 2 on this event", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.eventId == pm.collectionVariables.get("eventId")); pm.expect(r.waitlistPosition).to.eql(2); });

item.name: The event list shows seats and my status

exec: pm.test("Full, one waiting two, I am waitlisted", () => { const e = pm.response.json()[0]; pm.expect(e.spotsLeft).to.eql(0); pm.expect(e.waitlisted).to.eql(2); pm.expect(e.myStatus).to.eql("WAITLISTED"); });
pm.test("Confirmed now", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("reg2Id")); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("CONFIRMED"); });
pm.test("First in line", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.eventId == pm.collectionVariables.get("eventId")); pm.expect(r.waitlistPosition).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Employee 1 can register again (joins the waitlist, event is full)

exec: pm.test("Waitlisted behind employee 3", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("WAITLISTED"); pm.expect(r.waitlistPosition).to.eql(2); });

item.name: 6. Admin manages participants, capacity and cancellation
Participants: confirmed first, then the waitlist in order
Editing an event keeps its data
Raising capacity to 3 promotes the whole waitlist

exec: pm.test("Three confirmed, nobody waiting", () => { const e = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.confirmed).to.eql(3); pm.expect(e.waitlisted).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Admin sees all events including drafts

exec: pm.test("Contains this run's event", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(e => e.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("eventId"))).to.be.true);

item.name: A cancelled event cannot be edited
A cancelled event takes no registrations
